title: deactivate-request
description: POST /api/v1/devices/deactivate body - free a seat or move the main till to another PC. Sent by the branch's main till.

installId.description: The PC being released, when known.

reason.description: Why. Known values: transfer, replaced, removed, closed, other. Treat an unknown value as described in docs/web-portal-api.md section 17.11.
